_note: A verified worked example, not a template to copy. It expresses a real four-month-old personal knowledge base -- 214 sources, 45 people, 28 topics, 137 open items across four urgency levels, 18 recurring themes, 63 glossary terms, 20 promoted insights, a quarantine file and persisted proposals -- that was built independently of corp-os and shares none of its layer names. Content, vocabulary and domain have been replaced with neutral equivalents; only the SHAPE is real. Note what it disables: jobs and claims are both off. The open-items layer plays the role claims would, urgency-tiering plays the role a job's evidence list would, and decay is off because most entries trace to summaries no re-read could confirm. build_index.py renders all of it unchanged. The point of shipping this is that a system can score well on every dimension that matters while using none of the model's default layers.
